scope: Generic three-wall and gravity-seated roof fixtures, independent of source replicas. The seated roof has actual bearing area on its narrower U support. Three perturbation seeds, two-finger edge proxy and explicit one-panel supports. No physical human or magnetic-force certification.

build.title: Three-sided support
build.summary: Source-constrained reconstruction candidate. Read the independent evidence before building.

stages.title: U
stages.instruction: Support the first wall until the other two are joined.

result.detail: All operations passed with three perturbation seeds, at most two panel grips and mandatory free checkpoints. Fingertip-proxy simulation only; measured human grip and physical magnetic forces remain unverified.

operations.detail: Clear grip and insertion, connected closure and stable supported prefix; actual settled poses retained.

trials.detail: 1 separate hand contacts support 1 panels. No free-body stability is claimed; handoff/release must be checked separately.

grip.detail: Two-finger edge proxies clear the table, all present panels and each other. Palm, force and human dexterity remain uncalibrated.

carry.detail: One pickup panel completed the continuous held trajectory; every other panel remained dynamic, with swept solid/fingertip clearance and sustained rest.

closure.detail: First part/module placed; no pre-existing join required.
